card.name: Neck of a bottle or ampule
card.fires_on: The word neck when it names the narrow top of a bottle or ampule in preparation instructions. It also fires weakly on the middle of a few other words, such as BLE-ED-ING and Mini-S-pike.

modes.label: Neck of container
modes.description: The word neck refers to the opening of a bottle or ampule where an adapter goes in or a finger supports it.
